Five files, no package.json, no tests, no README. Plain Node, zero dependencies.

## Layers

```
server.js   HTTP front + auth gate
   ↓
routes.js   route table, query parse, JSON response
   ↓
cache.js    LRU read-through (reads only)
   ↓
store.js    in-memory Map with TTL
auth.js     HMAC token verify (used by server.js)
```

**`server.js:7`** — `createServer()` makes raw `node:http` server. Every request: `verifyToken` on `Authorization` header first. No user = 401, no route dispatch. Auth is global, not per-route. Self-starts on `PORT` or 8080 when run direct.

**`auth.js`** — bearer token format `<userId>.<hexSignature>`. Signature = HMAC-SHA256 of userId, secret from `AUTH_SECRET` env. `verifyToken` returns `{id: userId}` or null. Length check before `timingSafeEqual` (needed — that function throws on length mismatch).

**`routes.js:7`** — `TABLE` maps `"METHOD /path"` strings to handlers. Three routes: `GET /users`, `GET /orders`, `POST /orders`. Handlers get `(query, user)`. Miss = 404. Result wrapped in `Promise.resolve`, so sync and async handlers both work; resolve = 200 JSON, reject = 500 with error message.

**`cache.js`** — LRU, 256 entries, no TTL. Hit = delete + re-set to bump recency (Map preserves insertion order). Overflow evicts `lru.keys().next().value` (oldest). Reads only.

**`store.js`** — `Map` of `{value, expiresAt}`, 15-minute TTL from last write. Lazy expiry — checked on `get`, not swept. `listOrders` returns `[]` on miss; `putOrder` reads, pushes, writes back whole array.

## Gaps I'd flag

**Cache never invalidated.** `routes.js:5` comment claims writes "invalidate the affected keys" — no code does that. `POST /orders` writes to store; `orders:${user.id}` stays in LRU forever (no TTL there). Reads serve stale list until eviction by capacity pressure. Store TTL is also invisible to callers — cache returns a value the store already expired.

**`POST /orders` body never read.** `q.body` at `routes.js:10` comes from `parseQuery`, which only reads `u.searchParams`. Request stream never consumed. So every POST pushes `undefined` into the order array.

**No dev tooling.** No `package.json`, so no `npm start`, no deps pinned, no test runner. Run with `node src/server.js`.

**`AUTH_SECRET` defaults to `'dev-secret'`.** Ships silently in production if env unset — tokens forgeable by anyone who read this file.

Want me to fix the cache invalidation and body parsing, or write up a package.json + tests first?
